mapper.insert: /* ChkptResultHistMapper.insertAnswerHist */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ANSWER_HIST ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , CHKPT_CD , INSPECT_ITEM_CD , WORK_DATE , CHG_TYPE , INSPECT_ANSWER_TYPE , ANSWER_DESC , FILE_MGMT_CD , PERFORM_CMPNY_CD , PERFORM_USER_CD , PERFORM_USER_NM , ACTION_DTIME , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.CHKPT_CD , A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD , A.WORK_DATE , #{chgType} , A.INSPECT_ANSWER_TYPE , A.ANSWER_DESC , A.FILE_MGMT_CD , A.PERFORM_CMPNY_CD , A.PERFORM_USER_CD , A.PERFORM_USER_NM , NOW() , #{insertNo} , NOW() FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ANSWER A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.CHKPT_CD = #{chkptCd} AND A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{inspectItemCd} AND A.WORK_DATE = #{workDate}

/* ChkptResultHistMapper.insertDefectActionHist */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_DEFECT_ACTION_HIST ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , CHKPT_CD , INSPECT_ITEM_CD , WORK_DATE , CHG_TYPE , ACTION_DESC , FILE_MGMT_CD , ACTION_CMPNY_CD , ACTION_USER_CD , ACTION_USER_NM , ACTION_DTIME , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.CHKPT_CD , A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD , A.WORK_DATE , #{chgType} , A.ACTION_DESC , A.FILE_MGMT_CD , A.ACTION_CMPNY_CD , A.ACTION_USER_CD , A.ACTION_USER_NM , NOW() , #{insertNo} , NOW() FROM TB_CHKPT_DEFECT_ACTION A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.CHKPT_CD = #{chkptCd} AND A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{inspectItemCd} AND A.WORK_DATE = #{workDate}
